Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t…
Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are…
Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
translations.bsb: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
translations.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
translations.asv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, Whither I go, thou canst not follow now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.
